summary: Tested new Cuentas por Cobrar (CxC) module for both Óptica and Clínica NovaVision. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed covering responsables CRUD, listing/resumen for optica & clinica, creation, abono (partial/total), estado transitions, filtering by responsable, and validation (over-payment rejected 400). Frontend: pages /optica/cuentas-cobrar and /cuentas-cobrar-finanzas load correctly with summary cards, tabs (Cuentas/Responsables), and data table populated from backend. Sidebar submenus render under Óptica and Finanzas as expected.
action_items: Optional: cleanup TEST_ prefixed cuentas por cobrar left in DB from tests (not blocking; they are clearly prefixed).
critical_code_review_comments: cuentas_cobrar.py handles ObjectId correctly by projecting {_id:0} everywhere. Good.
PUT /responsables/{id} filters out None values but does not validate schema - would silently accept arbitrary fields; consider Pydantic model for updates.
generar_numero_cuenta has a race condition under concurrent creates (find last then +1). Low risk given per-user volume, but atomic counter or unique index recommended.
POST /abono for clinica creates caja movement but there's no reverse mechanism if abono is later voided; consider adding void/reversal endpoint.

Files CuentasCobrarOptica.js (766L) and CuentasCobrarFinanzas.js (1275L) are large; Finanzas file exceeds recommended 700-line threshold — consider splitting into subcomponents (ResponsablesTab, CuentasTab, AbonoModal).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed responsables and CxC records (auto cleaned partially via soft-delete of responsables). CxC records remain in DB with TEST_ prefix for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CxC module fully verified. Backend endpoints under /api/cuentas-cobrar/{optica,clinica,responsables,{id}/abono,tipos-responsable/lista}. Frontend routes /optica/cuentas-cobrar (paciente-based) and /cuentas-cobrar-finanzas (with Responsables/Cuentas tabs). Sidebar test-ids nav-optica-cxc and nav-cxc-finanzas exist but require parent Óptica/Finanzas menus expanded to be in DOM.
